verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a tax-filing portal, since tax agencies can and do expose authenticated filing APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no way to issue API credentials of any kind. Webfile is reachable only through an interactive authenticated eSystems session, and no OpenAPI spec was found. The only machine-readable rail is a keyless, read-only open-data endpoint on data.texas.gov, which is an adjacent feature and not a scoped credential.
